title: Privacy Policy
body: This website is an informational professional website. If you contact Alok Ranjan, the information you provide will be used to respond to your enquiry. Do not send confidential or time-sensitive information through this website. No information is sold. Reasonable steps should be taken to protect information, but no online transmission can be guaranteed secure. This policy may be updated as the website or applicable requirements change.
